definitionZh: :has-slotted CSS 伪类匹配,当一个位点元素的内容不是空的或者没有使用默认值(更多信息请参见使用模板和位点).
sourceDefinition: The :has-slotted CSS pseudo-class matches when the content of a slot element is not empty or not using the default value (see Using templates and slots for more information).
